Home.metaTitle: MoveYourBody - Personalized Micro-Workouts with On-Device AI
Home.metaDescription: MoveYourBody is a free, open-source fitness app by AOSSIE. Personalized 5–7 minute workouts that adapt to your goals, equipment and injuries, powered by on-device AI and voice control - fully offline and private.

Hero.mottoSubtitle:
Personalized 5–7 minute micro-workout sessions running 100% offline.

Powered by on-device AI and hands-free voice control.
Hero.heroBand: PRIVACY-FIRST • ON-DEVICE AI • ZERO USER TRACKING
Hero.modelAlt: An athlete stretching, arms raised overhead

Manifesto.lead: Five minutes. Three moves. Zero servers.
Manifesto.text: MoveYourBody builds every session around your goals, your equipment and your body, then learns from how it felt, entirely on your phone.

Features.title: A personal coach that fits in <hl>five minutes</hl>
Features.subtitle: Every session adapts to you: your goals, level, equipment, injuries, even how the last workout felt.

personalized.title: Personalized workouts
personalized.body: Sessions built from your goals, fitness level, preferences, available equipment and target body region. Try it:

short.title: Short, focused sessions
short.body: Quick micro-workouts that slot into a busy day. No hour at the gym required.
short.caption: 3 exercises

voice.title: Voice-controlled
voice.body: Say start, pause, skip or repeat, and hear it confirmed. Your hands stay on the workout, not the phone.

adaptive.title: Adapts after every session
adaptive.body: Rate how hard it felt and the next session adjusts difficulty and intensity, gradually rather than all at once.
adaptive.question: How did that feel?

safety.title: Safety-aware
safety.body: Mention an injury and exercises that could aggravate it are never recommended.
safety.label: I have a sore…

variety.title: Never the same session twice
variety.body: A variety engine remembers what you did recently and keeps rotating in fresh moves.

offline.title: Offline, on-device AI
offline.body: Recommendations run on a quantized MiniLM model inside your phone. No cloud round-trips, no waiting.

progress.title: Progress you can see
progress.body: Workout history, duration, calories and streaks, in charts and activity views.

reminders.title: Smart daily reminders
reminders.body: Pick your time and get a daily nudge.

custom.title: Custom workouts
custom.body: Mix your own routines from the library.

search.title: Exercise search
search.body: Find moves by name, body region or muscle.

focus.title: Body focus
focus.body: Ready-made upper body, lower body and core sessions.

HowItWorks.title: From a few answers to a plan that <hl>learns you</hl>
HowItWorks.subtitle: A small AI pipeline that lives on your phone, from onboarding to your next session.

onboard.title: Tell it about you
onboard.body: Share your goals, fitness level, equipment and any injuries, or describe them in your own words.

understand.title: Understood on-device
understand.body: A quantized all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence transformer turns your words into embeddings and maps them to exercise tags by cosine similarity.

filter.title: Filtered for safety, ranked for you
filter.body: Rule-based filters drop anything that clashes with your injuries or equipment. Scoring ranks what is left, skipping recent repeats.

move.title: Move, hands-free
move.body: Follow clear animations and timers, and steer the session with your voice.

adapt.title: Rate it, and it adapts
adapt.body: Your feedback updates your profile, so the next session lands closer to just right.

understand.title: Understanding you
understand.input: I sit all day and my lower back feels stiff

Privacy.title: Your health data <hl>never leaves your phone</hl>
Privacy.subtitle: Goals, injuries, workout history and anything you type are processed and stored on your device. Nothing is uploaded to servers run by the developers.

storage.title: Stored locally
storage.body: Your profile and history live in an on-device SQLite database.

ai.title: AI that runs locally
ai.body: Embeddings come from an ONNX model bundled with the app.

ads.title: No ads, no data sales
ads.body: Personal information is never sold, rented or shared.

control.title: Delete it any time
control.body: Clear the app’s storage or uninstall, and it is gone.

OpenSource.title: Built in the open by <hl>AOSSIE</hl>
OpenSource.subtitle: MoveYourBody is free software under the GNU GPL v3.0, developed by the AOSSIE community during Google Summer of Code 2026.

code.title: Code
code.body: Flutter UI, Riverpod state management, or the ONNX recommendation pipeline.

design.title: Design
design.body: Shape the app's screens and flows, and this website.

data.title: Exercise data
data.body: Grow the offline exercise library and its posture guidance.
